title: Objects
description:
## Objects
Objects group related data together with key-value pairs:

```ts
const video = {
    title: "Cat Falls",
    views: 5000,
    isPublic: true
};
```

### Accessing properties:
```ts
// Dot notation
console.log(video.title);    // Cat Falls

// Bracket notation
console.log(video["title"]); // Cat Falls

// Bracket notation with a variable
const key = "views";
console.log(video[key]);     // 5000
```

Both work the same. Bracket notation is useful when the key is stored in a variable.
